LanguageData.SakuraballBase.description: Paper bullets sealed with wax, containing round gold pellets and rosewood powder, can release the energy of the spell when fired from the smoothbore gun of the Yuran.
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuraball_M.label: sakuraball (blast)
LanguageData.Bullet_Sakuraball_M.label: sakuraball (blast)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuraball_F.label: sakuraball (sunlight)
LanguageData.Bullet_Sakuraball_F.label: sakuraball (sunlight)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuraball_L.label: sakuraball (thunder)
LanguageData.Bullet_Sakuraball_L.label: sakuraball (thunder)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuracannonball_Round.label: sakuracannonball (sun)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuracannonball_Round.description: The blazing ball shines in the eight directions, the mountain marrow burns through the tears of molten iron, and all sounds return to the void in silence.
LanguageData.Bullet_Sakuracannonball_Round.label: sakuracannonball (sun)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuracannonball_Incendiary.label: sakuracannonball (skyfire)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuracannonball_Incendiary.descrip: When the crimson light bursts, the celestial fire scorches the world, splitting the long night, and the ashes offer sacrifices to the heavens.
LanguageData.Bullet_Sakuracannonball_Incendiary.label: sakuracannonball (skyfire)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuracannonball_EMP.label: sakuracannonball (thunder)
LanguageData.Ammo_Sakuracannonball_EMP.description: The blazing cones burst into the marks of lightning, a thousand machines split their armor and buried their hearts, and the thunderbolts frightened their souls.
LanguageData.Bullet_Sakuracannonball_EMP.label: sakuracannonball (thunder)
LanguageData.SakuraLightBase.description: The energy of the sakura light shot out by the sacred gun bestowed by the gods was believed by the Miko to come from the sacred cherry blossoms they worshipped.
LanguageData.Ammo_SakuraLight.label: sakura light
LanguageData.Bullet_SakuraLight.label: sakura light
LanguageData.YR37mmBase.description: The dazzling flames, falling like raindrops, burn quietly and continuously until they turn the darkness into ashes in the midst of the brightness.
LanguageData.Ammo_YR37mm_F.label: YR37mm rocket (fire)
LanguageData.Bullet_YR37mm_F.label: YR37mm rocket (fire)
LanguageData.Ammo_YR37mm_E.label: YR37mm rocket (EMP)
LanguageData.Ammo_YR37mm_E.description: When the thunder rumbles in the rain, the world will fall into a state of complete silence.
LanguageData.Bullet_YR37mm_E.label: YR37mm rocket (EMP)
LanguageData.YuranarrowBase.description: The yuran arrow, wrapped with the power of exorcism, can be effective against all kinds of enemies.
LanguageData.Ammo_Yuranarrow_P.label: yuran arrow (AP)
LanguageData.Bullet_Yuranarrow_P.label: yuran arrow (AP)
LanguageData.Ammo_Yuranarrow_F.label: yuran arrow (exorciser)
LanguageData.Bullet_Yuranarrow_F.label: yuran arrow (exorciser)
LanguageData.YRBurstArrowBase.description: The sakura fire arrow, obtained by the shrine Miko praying in front of the sacred cherry blossom, is shot out in a Yu-Liu manner to purify the entire area of filth.
LanguageData.Ammo_YRBurstArrow_D.label: sakura burst arrow (divine)
LanguageData.Bullet_YRBurstArrow_D.label: sakura burst arrow (divine)
LanguageData.Ammo_YRBurstArrow_N.label: sakura burst arrow (normal)
LanguageData.Ammo_YRBurstArrow_N.description: The fire arrow for purifying demons, crafted by a shrine Miko with blessings, can penetrate the armor of powerful evil spirits.
LanguageData.Bullet_YRBurstArrow_N.label: sakura burst arrow (normal)
LanguageData.YRkunai.label: yuran kunai
LanguageData.YRMortarArrowBase.description: The curving projectile shell fired in the style of Yangliu can rain down infernal fire upon the enemy like meteorites.
LanguageData.Shell_YRMortarArrow.label: infernal meteor shell
LanguageData.Bullet_YRMortarArrow.label: infernal meteor shell
LanguageData.YRrocketArrowBase.description: The curving projectile shell fired in the style of Yangliu can rain down infernal fire upon the enemy like meteorites.
LanguageData.Shell_YRrocketArrow_Fire.label: golden firebird rocket
LanguageData.Shell_YRrocketArrow_Fire.description: The golden firebird crashed head-on into the enemy formation, and then transformed into a small sun rising on the surface of the earth.
LanguageData.Bullet_YRrocketArrow_Fire.label: golden firebird rocket
LanguageData.Shell_YRrocketArrow_EMP.label: silver bird rocket
LanguageData.Shell_YRrocketArrow_EMP.description: The divine bird flying through the thunderclouds, when it strikes evil, the silver light will burst out like mercury flowing to the ground.
LanguageData.Bullet_YRrocketArrow_EMP.label: silver bird rocket
LanguageData.YR_Bomb.label: spell blast
LanguageData.YR_Flame.label: spell burn
